metadata.name: List browser tabs
metadata.author: recued-core
metadata.description: Use “List browser tabs” in Recued. List the web pages open in Chrome through the Browser Bridge, up to 50, each with its address, title and a page handle for the other Browser Toolkit recipes. Changes nothing. Not needed for a page whose address you have: the reads and Act on web pages take the address, using the tab showing it or opening one.
